text:
Ravi Kapoor: @here Announcing GA for Hosted Prism (hosted-prism.v1) — optimized for multimodal tool-calling and stable streaming across regions :tada:

Ravi Kapoor: Endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-prism

Ravi Kapoor: Quick notes: multiplexed tool-calling enabled, streaming chunking improved, and a new default quant profile 'prism-fast' applied for balanced latency/cost. Beta path will be retired in 30 days.

DeployBot: deploy-bot: hosted-prism.v1 rollout succeeded in us-east-1, eu-west-1, us-west-2 (nodes: 320). No incidents reported. :white_check_mark:

Marta Silva: Who needs to be informed about SDK changes? Any breaking changes to tool-calling schema?

Ravi Kapoor: Marta Silva: SDKs updated (python/js/go). No breaking changes for basic flows; advanced multiplexing requires SDK v0.13+. Migration samples coming in the docs.

Ivy Chen: Can we get the Console panel link for observability and cost charts? Need to update partner materials.

Ravi Kapoor: Ivy Chen: Console -> Models -> hosted-prism.v1. Added per-model cost heatmap, tool-call latency percentiles, and streaming chunk-size distribution. Docs PR #4821; will pin in #product-docs.

Sam Reynolds: Nice work. Note: we enabled a 14-day compatibility flag on the beta path and will fully deprecate after 30 days. Please report regressions to #incidents and tag @eng-oncall.

Marta Silva: Scheduling a 20m walkthrough for partners tomorrow 10:00 PT to cover SDK samples and migration FAQ.

Ravi Kapoor: Thanks everyone — huge props to runtime, infra, and devex teams :rocket:
